meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: Claude 会读取中央数据库和 .env,帮你把 Slack、Telegram 等消息渠道接到 agent 群组:选隔离方式、跑注册步骤、改已有接线,并列出已接、已配未接和未配置的渠道。
howto.when: 在你刚添加一个渠道后、做初始配置时,或想重新调整渠道与 agent 群组的接线时接管。

say.text: 我加了个新的 Slack 渠道,帮我把它接上
say.note: 它会先问平台 ID 和隔离方式

say.text: 把 Telegram 那个群改成接到另一个 agent
say.note: 会删除旧接线并新建一条

say.text: 给我看下现在的渠道配置
say.note: 列出已接、未接和未配置的渠道

howto.what_en: Claude reads the central database and .env, then wires messaging channels to agent groups: picks an isolation mode, runs the register step, edits existing wirings, and lists wired, configured-but-unwired, and unconfigured channels.
howto.when_en: It takes over after you add a channel, during initial setup, or when you want to reconfigure how channels connect to agent groups.

say_en.text: I added a new Slack channel, wire it up
say_en.note: It asks for the platform ID and isolation mode

say_en.text: Move that Telegram group to another agent
say_en.note: Deletes the old wiring and creates a new one

say_en.text: Show me the current channel configuration
say_en.note: Lists wired, unwired and unconfigured channels
